headline: Minnesota State hold opponents to eleven goals
dek: Lauren McAlpine has kept sixteen shutouts for Minnesota State, whose only defeat of the season came at Minnesota Duluth in October. UMary, beaten by them in September, sit level with them on points at the top of the table.

wire.line: UMary's Dina Polanco has scored twenty goals from 102 shots this season.
